statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmia detected or excluded during monitoring directly informs the management of the transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
Diagnosis codes G45.9, I34.0, Z86.73 were submitted
The denial reason code is PR-204
